newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's share market jumps to record high.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's share market jumps to record high.

text.p: The Budapest stock market opened at a record level and the BUX index traded in uncharted territory, on the back of fresh capital inflow and a powerful dollar, traders said.
The BUX index opened at 7,379.24 points, compared to Monday's close of 7,269.94 points, and above its all-time high of 7,296.64 points, reached on July 9.
At 1000 GMT the BUX stood at 7,394.82 points, up 124.88.
"There's a lot of money flowing into Hungary, as a result the market's optimism is unchanged," said Peter Tolgyesi of Buda-Cash Brokerhaz. "The other factor is the dollar's continuous rise."
Just before 1000 GMT the forint traded at 192.05/10 to the dollar, compared 191.25/30 at opening.

Another trader underlined the dollar's importance and also saw the inflow of fresh capital both from foreign and domestic clients. But he added that high prices about 20 minutes after the start of trade had persuaded some investors to sell.
"The market opened very high and some are selling," said Tamas Revesz of Wintrust, but added that he expected to market to maintain this level by the end of play.
